title: Optimize: integrate SCM into what-if sweeps + confidence guardrails
author: Hassan Mirza
description: This wires the Optimize what-if evaluator into the Standard Cost Model (SCM) service so recommendation deltas are computed from a versioned, deterministic cost breakdown (instead of Optimize-local heuristics). The integration supports scenario sweeps (batching/caching/quant profile candidates) and introduces hard guardrails to prevent emitting misleading recommendations when SCM confidence is low or assumptions materially diverge from the baseline run. Scope: add SCM client + request builders for sweep candidates; translate Optimize scenario templates into SCM Estimate inputs; compute normalized deltas (total + breakdown) per candidate; enforce confidence gating (min confidence, max assumptions delta, required signals) with reason codes surfaced in Optimize output; add per-sweep rate limits + request chunking to keep SCM p95 within SLO; add metrics/tracing around SCM dependency and cache behavior; include golden tests for determinism and a staging-only integration test that runs a small sweep pack. Notes: This does not change customer billing; results remain technical estimates for Optimize UI and internal reporting only. Rollout: behind optimize.scmWhatIf.enabled and optimize.scmWhatIf.confidenceGate.enabled with tenant allowlist; fallback is existing heuristic cost model if SCM is unavailable or returns UNSUPPORTED_VERSION. Checklist: [x] Unit tests for candidate translation and delta math; [x] Golden tests for deterministic ordering of breakdown components; [x] Metrics (scm_client_latency_ms, scm_client_errors_total, scm_sweep_candidates_total, scm_guardrail_blocks_total); [x] Docs in /docs/internal/optimize/scm-whatif; [x] Feature flags wired; [x] Staging verification run (see comment).

Hassan Mirza (author): Client sends X-Redwood-SCM-Version: 1 and Accept-Version: 1..1; on UNSUPPORTED_VERSION we fall back to heuristic model and emit metric scm_version_fallback_total. Added unit test to cover UNSUPPORTED_VERSION path.

Hassan Mirza (author): Removed tenant_id from default labels; kept tenant_tier (hosted/dedicated/private) and region. Added sampling for per-request debug logs behind optimize.scmWhatIf.debugLogging.
Dr. Maya Srinivasan: Quant profile swapping: do we apply any sanity checks so we don't recommend a profile that increases estimated cost but claims quality improvements? Or vice versa?

Hassan Mirza (author): This PR only addresses cost; quality gating remains in the recommender stage. However, I added a guardrail: if SCM returns confidence < 0.7 for quantization-related assumptions (quant_profile_metadata_missing), we block quant swap recommendations specifically and allow batch/cache recs to proceed.

Hassan Mirza (author): Added chunking at 20 candidates/request and max 4 concurrent SCM calls per sweep; overall cap of 200 candidates/sweep with a clear error message if exceeded; also added simple request memoization keyed by (model, sku, quant_profile, cache_mode, batch_config) for the duration of a sweep.

Added confidence/assumption guardrails to block recommendations when SCM inputs are incomplete or low-confidence.
